build_vertex_ai_video_request: build a Vertex AI Veo video generation request by transforming OpenAI-style parameters to Veo format
transform_video_creation_response: transform a Veo API long-running operation response into a VideoObject with processing status
extract_model_from_operation_name: extract the model name from a Vertex AI operation name string
transform_video_status_retrieve_request: transform a video status retrieval request to poll a Veo operation via fetchPredictOperation
transform_video_content_response: transform a completed Veo operation response by extracting and decoding base64 video data to bytes
